sanskrit: taṃ sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇam saṃpariṣvajya kaunteyaḥ saṃdeṣṭum upacakrame
english: Embracing him who was endowed with all virtues and bore the Śrīvatsa mark, the son of Kuntī began to give his instructions.

sanskrit: yā sā bālyāt prabhṛty asmān paryavardhayatābalā upavāsatapaḥśīlā sadā svastyayane ratā
english: She who, from our very childhood, reared us — that woman of fasting and austerity, ever devoted to our well-being and welfare —

sanskrit: devatātithipūjāsu guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratā vatsalā priyaputrā ca priyāsmākaṃ janārdana
english: devoted to the worship of gods and guests, diligent in service to elders, affectionate, fond of her sons, and dear to us, O Janārdana —

sanskrit: suyodhanabhayād yā no 'trāyatāmitrakarśana mahato mṛtyusaṃbādhād uttaran naur ivārṇavāt
english: she who saved us from the great peril of death out of fear of Suyodhana, O crusher of foes, like a ship lifting one from the ocean —

sanskrit: asmatkṛte ca satataṃ yayā duḥkhāni mādhava anubhūtāny aduḥkhārhā tāṃ sma pṛccher anāmayam
english: she who, though undeserving of sorrow, has continually suffered hardships on our account — please inquire of her welfare, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: bhṛśam āśvāsayeś caināṃ putraśokapariplutām abhivādya svajethāś ca pāṇḍavān parikīrtayan
english: Greatly console her who is overwhelmed by grief for her sons; salute her and embrace her, proclaiming the names of the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: ūḍhāt prabhṛti duḥkhāni śvaśurāṇām ariṃdama nikārān atadarhā ca paśyantī duḥkham aśnute
english: From the time of her marriage, O crusher of foes, she has witnessed the indignities and sufferings of her fathers-in-law, undeserving as she was of such grief.

sanskrit: api jātu sa kālaḥ syāt kṛṣṇa duḥkhaviparyayaḥ yad ahaṃ mātaraṃ kliṣṭāṃ sukhe dadhyām ariṃdama
english: Will there ever come a time, O Kṛṣṇa, O crusher of foes, when I might place my afflicted mother in happiness?

sanskrit: pravrajanto 'nvadhāvat sā kṛpaṇā putragṛddhinī rudatīm apahāyainām upagacchāma yad vanam
english: When we went forth into the forest, she, pitiable and attached to her sons, followed after us weeping; yet we departed into the forest leaving her behind in tears.

sanskrit: na nūnaṃ mriyate duḥkhaiḥ sā cej jīvati keśava tathā putrādhibhir gāḍham ārtā hy ānartasatkṛtā
english: Surely grief does not kill — for if she still lives, O Keśava, she has been deeply afflicted by sorrow over her sons, yet honored by the people of Ānarta.

sanskrit: abhivādyā tu sā kṛṣṇa tvayā madvacanād vibho dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca kauravyo rājānaś ca vayo 'dhikāḥ
english: She, O Kṛṣṇa, O lord, must be saluted on my behalf; and so must Dhṛtarāṣṭra of the Kuru line, and all the kings who are older in years.

sanskrit: bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva mahārājaṃ ca bāhlikam drauṇiṃ ca somadattaṃ ca sarvāṃś ca bharatān pṛthak
english: Bhīṣma, Droṇa, and Kṛpa, the great king Bāhlika, Drauṇi, Somadatta, and all the Bharatas individually —

sanskrit: viduraṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ kurūṇāṃ mantradhāriṇam agādhabuddhiṃ dharmajñaṃ svajethā madhusūdana
english: and Vidura, the greatly wise, keeper of counsel for the Kurus, of unfathomable intellect and knower of dharma — embrace him, O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit: ity uktvā keśavaṃ tatra rājamadhye yudhiṣṭhiraḥ anujñāto nivavṛte kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam
english: Having said this to Keśava there in the midst of the kings, Yudhiṣṭhira, given leave, circumambulated Kṛṣṇa and withdrew.

sanskrit: vrajann eva tu bībhatsuḥ sakhāyaṃ puruṣarṣabham abravīt paravīraghnaṃ dāśārham aparājitam
english: Even as he was departing, Bībhatsu addressed his friend, that bull among men, the slayer of enemy heroes, the undefeated scion of the Dāśārhas.

sanskrit: yad asmākaṃ vibho vṛttaṃ purā vai mantraniścaye ardharājyasya govinda viditaṃ sarvarājasu
english: What transpired for us, O lord, in the former deliberation regarding half the kingdom, O Govinda — that is known among all the kings.

sanskrit: tac ced dadyād asaṅgena satkṛtyānavamanya ca priyaṃ me syān mahābāho mucyeran mahato bhayāt
english: If he should give that without obstruction, honoring us and not slighting us, it would be dear to me, O mighty-armed one, and they would be freed from great peril.

sanskrit: ataś ced anyathā kartā dhārtarāṣṭro 'nupāyavit antaṃ nūnaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣatriyāṇāṃ janārdana
english: But if the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, ignorant of proper means, acts otherwise than this, I shall surely bring the kṣatriyas to their end, O Janārdana.

sanskrit: evam ukte pāṇḍavena paryahṛṣyad vṛkodaraḥ muhur muhuḥ krodhavaśāt prāvepata ca pāṇḍavaḥ
english: When the Pāṇḍava had spoken thus, Vṛkodara rejoiced greatly; again and again that Pāṇḍava trembled, overcome with anger.

sanskrit: vepamānaś ca kaunteyaḥ prākrośan mahato ravān dhanaṃjayavacaḥ śrutvā harṣotsiktamanā bhṛśam
english: The son of Kuntī trembled and uttered great loud cries; having heard the words of Dhanañjaya, his mind was greatly swollen with joy.

sanskrit: tasya taṃ ninadaṃ śrutvā saṃprāvepanta dhanvinaḥ vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi śakṛnmūtraṃ prasusruvuḥ
english: Hearing that roar of his, the bowmen trembled; all the animals voided their dung and urine.

sanskrit: ity uktvā keśavaṃ tatra tathā coktvā viniścayam anujñāto nivavṛte pariṣvajya janārdanam
english: Having thus spoken to Keśava there, and having declared his resolve, he was given leave, embraced Janārdana, and withdrew.

sanskrit: teṣu rājasu sarveṣu nivṛtteṣu janārdanaḥ tūrṇam abhyapatad dhṛṣṭaḥ sainyasugrīvavāhanaḥ
english: When all those kings had departed, Janārdana, bold, mounted swiftly on his chariot drawn by Śaibya and Sugrīva.

sanskrit: te hayā vāsudevasya dārukeṇa pracoditāḥ panthānam ācemur iva grasamānā ivāmbaram
english: Those horses of Vāsudeva, urged on by Dāruka, seemed to devour the road and swallow the sky.

sanskrit: athāpaśyan mahābāhur ṛṣīn adhvani keśavaḥ brāhmyā śriyā dīpyamānān sthitān ubhayataḥ pathi
english: Then the mighty-armed Keśava saw sages on the road, blazing with brahmic splendor, standing on both sides of the path.

sanskrit: so 'vatīrya rathāt tūrṇam abhivādya janārdanaḥ yathāvat tān ṛṣīn sarvān abhyabhāṣata pūjayan
english: Descending quickly from his chariot, Janārdana saluted and addressed all those sages duly, honoring them.

sanskrit: kaccil lokeṣu kuśalaṃ kaccid dharmaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ trayo varṇāḥ kaccit tiṣṭhanti śāsane
english: "Is all well in the worlds? Is dharma properly observed? Do the three varṇas remain under the guidance of the brāhmaṇas?"

sanskrit: tebhyaḥ prayujya tāṃ pūjāṃ provāca madhusūdanaḥ bhagavantaḥ kva saṃsiddhāḥ kā vīthī bhavatām iha
english: Having offered them that reverence, Madhusūdana said: "O venerable ones, where are you perfected ones coming from? What is your path here?"

sanskrit: kiṃ vā bhagavatāṃ kāryam ahaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ kenārthenopasaṃprāptā bhagavanto mahītalam
english: "Or what is the business of the venerable ones? What may I do for you? For what purpose have you, O venerable ones, come to this earth?"

sanskrit: tam abravīj jāmadagnya upetya madhusūdanam pariṣvajya ca govindaṃ purā sucarite sakhā
english: Jāmadagnya approached Madhusūdana and, embracing Govinda — a friend from long ago, of noble conduct — spoke to him.

sanskrit: devarṣayaḥ puṇyakṛto brāhmaṇāś ca bahuśrutāḥ rājarṣayaś ca dāśārha mānayantas tapasvinaḥ
english: "Divine seers, doers of merit, brāhmaṇas of great learning, and royal seers, O scion of Dāśārha, honoring the ascetics —

sanskrit: devāsurasya draṣṭāraḥ purāṇasya mahādyute sametaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ didṛkṣantaś ca sarvataḥ
english: — witnesses to the ancient struggle of gods and asuras, O greatly resplendent one, and wishing to behold the assembled earthly kṣatriyas from all sides —

sanskrit: sabhāsadaś ca rājānas tvāṃ ca satyaṃ janārdana etan mahat prekṣaṇīyaṃ draṣṭuṃ gacchāma keśava
english: — and the kings in the assembly, and you yourself in truth, O Janārdana — we go to witness this great spectacle, O Keśava."

sanskrit: dharmārthasahitā vācaḥ śrotum icchāma mādhava tvayocyamānāḥ kuruṣu rājamadhye paraṃtapa
english: "We wish to hear words joined with dharma and purpose, O Mādhava, spoken by you among the Kurus in the midst of kings, O scorcher of foes."

sanskrit: bhīṣmadroṇādayaś caiva viduraś ca mahāmatiḥ tvaṃ ca yādavaśārdūla sabhāyāṃ vai sameṣyatha
english: "Bhīṣma, Droṇa and the others, and Vidura of great mind, and you yourself, O tiger among Yādavas, will assemble in that hall."

sanskrit: tava vākyāni divyāni tatra teṣāṃ ca mādhava śrotum icchāma govinda satyāni ca śubhāni ca
english: "Your divine words there, and theirs as well, O Mādhava, we wish to hear, O Govinda — words that are true and auspicious."

sanskrit: āpṛṣṭo 'si mahābāho punar drakṣyāmahe vayam yāhy avighnena vai vīra drakṣyāmas tvāṃ sabhāgatam
english: "You have been asked, O mighty-armed one; we shall see you again. Go without obstacle, O hero; we shall see you when you have arrived at the assembly."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca prayāntaṃ devakīputraṃ paravīrarujo daśa mahārathā mahābāhum anvayuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Ten great chariot-warriors, weapons in hand, followed the son of Devakī, the mighty-armed crusher of enemy heroes, as he departed.

sanskrit: padātīnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sādināṃ ca paraṃtapa bhojyaṃ ca vipulaṃ rājan preṣyāś ca śataśo 'pare
english: A thousand foot soldiers and cavalry as well, O scorcher of foes, and abundant provisions, O king, and hundreds of servants besides.

sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca kathaṃ prayāto dāśārho mahātmā madhusūdanaḥ kāni vā vrajatas tasya nimittāni mahaujasaḥ
english: Janamejaya said: How did the great-souled Madhusūdana, scion of the Dāśārhas, depart? And what omens appeared for that one of mighty power as he traveled?

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tasya prayāṇe yāny āsann adbhutāni mahātmanaḥ tāni me śṛṇu divyāni daivāny autpātikāni ca
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: The wondrous signs that attended the departure of that great soul — hear those from me: divine, heaven-sent, and portentous.

sanskrit: anabhre 'śaninirghoṣaḥ savidyutsamajāyata anvag eva ca parjanyaḥ prāvarṣad vighane bhṛśam
english: In a cloudless sky a peal of thunder with lightning arose; and immediately after, rain fell heavily in a thick downpour.

sanskrit: pratyag ūhur mahānadyaḥ prāṅmukhāḥ sindhusattamāḥ viparītā diśaḥ sarvā na prājñāyata kiṃ cana
english: The great rivers, those best of streams flowing eastward, reversed their course; all directions were inverted and nothing could be distinguished.

sanskrit: prājvalann agnayo rājan pṛthivī samakampata udapānāś ca kumbhāś ca prāsiñcañ śataśo jalam
english: Fires blazed up, O king; the earth trembled; wells and water jars poured forth water in hundreds of streams.

sanskrit: tamaḥsaṃvṛtam apy āsīt sarvaṃ jagad idaṃ tadā na diśo nādiśo rājan prajñāyante sma reṇunā
english: The entire world was enveloped in darkness at that time; the directions and intermediate directions, O king, could not be discerned because of the dust.

sanskrit: prādurāsīn mahāñ śabdaḥ khe śarīraṃ na dṛśyate sarveṣu rājan deśeṣu tad adbhutam ivābhavat
english: A great sound arose in the sky with no body visible; in all regions, O king, that seemed like a wonder indeed.

sanskrit: prāmathnād dhāstinapuraṃ vāto dakṣiṇapaścimaḥ ārujan gaṇaśo vṛkṣān paruṣo bhīmanisvanaḥ
english: A south-westerly wind battered Hāstinapura, harsh and dreadful in sound, uprooting trees in great numbers.

sanskrit: yatra yatra tu vārṣṇeyo vartate pathi bhārata tatra tatra sukho vāyuḥ sarvaṃ cāsīt pradakṣiṇam
english: But wherever the Vārṣṇeya traveled on the road, O Bhārata, there the wind was pleasant and all things were auspicious.

sanskrit: vavarṣa puṣpavarṣaṃ ca kamalāni ca bhūriśaḥ samaś ca panthā nirduḥkho vyapetakuśakaṇṭakaḥ
english: A rain of flowers fell and lotuses in great abundance; the road was level, free of hardship, free of sharp grass and thorns.

sanskrit: sa gacchan brāhmaṇai rājaṃs tatra tatra mahābhujaḥ arcyate madhuparkaiś ca sumanobhir vasupradaḥ
english: As he traveled, O king, that mighty-armed giver of wealth was worshipped by brāhmaṇas here and there with honey-offerings and flowers.

sanskrit: taṃ kiranti mahātmānaṃ vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ striyaḥ pathi samāgamya sarvabhūtahite ratam
english: Women came together along the road to scatter fragrant wild flowers upon that great soul who was devoted to the welfare of all beings.

sanskrit: sa śālibhavanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvasasyasamācitam sukhaṃ paramadharmiṣṭham atyagād bharatarṣabha
english: He passed through a beautiful tract of rice fields filled with all manner of crops, pleasant and most righteous, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: paśyan bahupaśūn grāmān ramyān hṛdayatoṣaṇān purāṇi ca vyatikrāman rāṣṭrāṇi vividhāni ca
english: Beholding villages rich in cattle, lovely and heart-pleasing, he passed through towns and various kingdoms.

sanskrit: nityahṛṣṭāḥ sumanaso bhāratair abhirakṣitāḥ nodvignāḥ paracakrāṇām anayānām akovidāḥ
english: Always joyful and cheerful of mind, protected by the Bharatas, the people were untroubled, unaware of the misdeeds of enemy forces.

sanskrit: upaplavyād athāyāntaṃ janāḥ puranivāsinaḥ pathy atiṣṭhanta sahitā viṣvaksenadidṛkṣayā
english: Then the townsfolk, having learned of his coming from Upaplavya, stood together on the road, eager to see Viṣvaksena.

sanskrit: te tu sarve sunāmānam agnim iddham iva prabhum arcayām āsur arcyaṃ taṃ deśātithim upasthitam
english: All of them worshipped him, the worshipful lord of beautiful name, like a blazing fire — that honored guest who had arrived in their land.

sanskrit: vṛkasthalaṃ samāsādya keśavaḥ paravīrahā prakīrṇaraśmāv āditye vimale lohitāyati
english: Keśava, slayer of enemy heroes, reached Vṛkasthala as the sun, clear and reddening, was spreading its rays at sunset.

sanskrit: avatīrya rathāt tūrṇaṃ kṛtvā śaucaṃ yathāvidhi rathamocanam ādiśya saṃdhyām upaviveśa ha
english: Descending swiftly from his chariot, performing his ablutions according to rule, ordering the unharnessing of the chariot, he sat down to perform the evening rite.

sanskrit: dāruko 'pi hayān muktvā paricarya ca śāstrataḥ mumoca sarvaṃ varmāṇi muktvā cainān avāsṛjat
english: Dāruka too released the horses, tended to them according to scripture, removed all armor, and set them free to roam.

sanskrit: abhyatītya tu tat sarvam uvāca madhusūdanaḥ yudhiṣṭhirasya kāryārtham iha vatsyāmahe kṣapām
english: Having completed all of that, Madhusūdana said: "For the sake of Yudhiṣṭhira's mission we shall spend the night here."

sanskrit: tasya tan matam ājñāya cakrur āvasathaṃ narāḥ kṣaṇena cānnapānāni guṇavanti samārjayan
english: Understanding his wish, the men prepared lodgings for him; and in a moment they gathered food and drink of fine quality.

sanskrit: tasmin grāme pradhānās tu ya āsan brāhmaṇā nṛpa āryāḥ kulīnā hrīmanto brāhmīṃ vṛttim anuṣṭhitāḥ
english: The leading brāhmaṇas of that village, O king — noble, of good lineage, modest, observing the brahmic way of life —

sanskrit: te 'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ hṛṣīkeśam ariṃdamam pūjāṃ cakrur yathānyāyam āśīrmaṅgalasaṃyutām
english: — they approached the great-souled Hṛṣīkeśa, crusher of foes, and offered worship duly, accompanied by blessings and auspicious rites.

sanskrit: te pūjayitvā dāśārhaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam nyavedayanta veśmāni ratnavanti mahātmane
english: Having honored the scion of Dāśārha, who is worshipped in all worlds, they offered their gem-filled dwellings to the great soul.

sanskrit: tān prabhuḥ kṛtam ity uktvā satkṛtya ca yathārhataḥ abhyetya teṣāṃ veśmāni punar āyāt sahaiva taiḥ
english: The lord, saying "it is done," honored them duly; going to their dwellings he returned again together with them.

sanskrit: sumṛṣṭaṃ bhojayitvā ca brāhmaṇāṃs tatra keśavaḥ bhuktvā ca saha taiḥ sarvair avasat tāṃ kṣapāṃ sukham
english: Having fed the brāhmaṇas there with well-prepared food, and having eaten himself together with all of them, Keśava passed that night pleasantly.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tathā dūtaiḥ samājñāya āyāntaṃ madhusūdanam dhṛtarāṣṭro 'bravīd bhīṣmam arcayitvā mahābhujam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having thus learned through messengers of Madhusūdana's arrival, Dhṛtarāṣṭra addressed the mighty-armed Bhīṣma with reverence.

sanskrit: droṇaṃ ca saṃjayaṃ caiva viduraṃ ca mahāmatim duryodhanaṃ ca sāmātyaṃ hṛṣṭaromābravīd idam
english: And Droṇa, Saṃjaya, the greatly wise Vidura, and Duryodhana with his ministers — with hair standing on end he spoke these words:

sanskrit: adbhutaṃ mahad āścaryaṃ śrūyate kurunandana striyo bālāś ca vṛddhāś ca kathayanti gṛhe gṛhe
english: "A great wonder and marvel is being reported, O joy of the Kurus; women, children, and the aged are speaking of it house by house."

sanskrit: satkṛtyācakṣate cānye tathaivānye samāgatāḥ pṛthagvādāś ca vartante catvareṣu sabhāsu ca
english: "Others recount it with praise; still other groups have gathered; diverse discussions are going on in the crossroads and assemblies."

sanskrit: upayāsyati dāśārhaḥ pāṇḍavārthe parākramī sa no mānyaś ca pūjyaś ca sarvathā madhusūdanaḥ
english: "The heroic scion of Dāśārha will come on behalf of the Pāṇḍavas; that Madhusūdana is deserving of our honor and reverence in every way."

sanskrit: tasmin hi yātrā lokasya bhūtānām īśvaro hi saḥ tasmin dhṛtiś ca vīryaṃ ca prajñā caujaś ca mādhave
english: "For in him lies the journey of the world; he is indeed the lord of all beings. In that Mādhava reside steadiness, valor, wisdom, and might."

sanskrit: sa mānyatāṃ naraśreṣṭhaḥ sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ pūjito hi sukhāya syād asukhaḥ syād apūjitaḥ
english: "Let that best of men be honored; for he is eternal dharma itself. When honored, he brings happiness; when not honored, he brings unhappiness."

sanskrit: sa cet tuṣyati dāśārha upacārair ariṃdamaḥ kṛtsnān sarvān abhiprāyān prāpsyāmaḥ sarvarājasu
english: "If that scion of Dāśārha, that crusher of foes, is pleased by our attentions, we shall attain all our intentions among all the kings."

sanskrit: tasya pūjārtham adyaiva saṃvidhatsva paraṃtapa sabhāḥ pathi vidhīyantāṃ sarvakāmasamāhitāḥ
english: "Arrange today itself for his worship, O scorcher of foes; let rest-halls be established on the road, furnished with all desirable things."

sanskrit: yathā prītir mahābāho tvayi jāyeta tasya vai tathā kuruṣva gāndhāre kathaṃ vā bhīṣma manyase
english: "Do whatever will cause his affection to arise toward you, O mighty-armed Gāndhārī's son; and what is your opinion, O Bhīṣma?"

sanskrit: tato bhīṣmādayaḥ sarve dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ janādhipam ūcuḥ paramam ity evaṃ pūjayanto 'sya tad vacaḥ
english: Then Bhīṣma and all the others said to Dhṛtarāṣṭra, lord of the people: "Excellent" — thus honoring his words.

sanskrit: teṣām anumataṃ jñātvā rājā duryodhanas tadā sabhāvāstūni ramyāṇi pradeṣṭum upacakrame
english: Knowing their approval, King Duryodhana then proceeded to designate beautiful sites for the halls of reception.

sanskrit: tato deśeṣu deśeṣu ramaṇīyeṣu bhāgaśaḥ sarvaratnasamākīrṇāḥ sabhāś cakrur anekaśaḥ
english: Then in pleasant places, portion by portion, they constructed numerous halls filled with all manner of jewels.

sanskrit: āsanāni vicitrāṇi yuktāni vividhair guṇaiḥ striyo gandhān alaṃkārān sūkṣmāṇi vasanāni ca
english: Variegated seats furnished with various fine qualities, women with perfumes, ornaments, and fine garments —
